## Flux Hands 1.0.13

- Adds user approval and rejection for proposed OpenHands tool actions.
- Binds desktop file operations and workspace utilities to the selected project.
- Persists and migrates the selected project folder.

## Test status

This is a beta test build, not a stable readiness claim. Rust unit tests (8) and the frontend production build pass. Windows NSIS/MSI and an Android ARM64 debug APK build locally; this machine cannot create the official updater signature because the signing key is held by GitHub Actions. The Android APK package and signature are verified, but it has not been installed on a phone. The OpenHands approval flow has not been exercised end to end. Test carefully and report failures before relying on it for important work.
